QuestInfo.name: Skill Effect Item, <Skill Skin>!
QuestInfo.0: Hear about how to use #b#e<Skill Skin>#k#n effect items!
QuestInfo.2:
#e#bWhat are <Skill Skins>?#k#n
They are items that let you change the appearance of your skills.

#e#bWhere is the Skill Skin Inventory?#k#n
Click the <Skill Skin> button in your Skill Inventory.

#e#bHow do I equip a Skill Skin?#k#n
Double-click the item or place the item on the selected skill.

#e#bHow do I unequip a Skill Skin?#k#n
Drag it off of the skill and back to your Inventory.
